chapter: Childhood and family in New Orleans
title: Opening, name and birth date
summary: Morgan gives his name and says he was born August 19, about 1912, on the day of the interview.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: Okay, I guess it's going if you want to give your name. You don't have to get close, just sit back and relax.
You don't pick up anything in the room.
So my name is Al Morgan.
Is there any middle name by the way?
No, my full name called me Albert. But I don't know. I've always interviewed everybody I went to, he says, they're like Al for short.
I don't remember until last night I heard somebody call you Albert. When were you born? Do you remember your birth date exactly?
Oh, yes. I was born about 42 years ago. It's August 19th, by the way, today is my birthday. Oh, exactly.
What a diamond. What was the year then? It seems 19.
Oh, boy. Let me see. We'll have to go.
Like that. That should be, for now, about 1912. 1912. Something like that.
